context: Naoko hosts a birthday party at the shop; many small touches.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、ベル、ピーン!
lines.style: Bright, carrying call with Kansai brightness. Sharp 'ding' sound on the particle. Loud, warm—the cheerful aunt summoning her niece to something good. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祝い、楽しい雰囲気ね。
lines.en: A celebration—and such a nice atmosphere for it.
lines.style: Appreciative, present. Soft smile in the voice. Gentle acknowledgment of both the occasion and her aunt's effort. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 稽古、ようけしてた、料理もな。
lines.en: She's been practicing so much—and the food, too.
lines.style: Proud, Kansai warmth underneath. Slight emphasis on 'so much'—not boasting, affirming. Tender recognition. The voice of an aunt who watches and remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お料理の広がり、好評ですね。
lines.en: And all this food—it's really been a hit.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, soft and sincere. Not flattering—observing. The slight wonder of someone noticing everyone enjoying something someone she loves made.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 止まったら、こっち、よろしくな!
lines.en: When you're done over there, come over here, yeah?
lines.style: Hospitable, Kansai directness with real warmth. Not demanding—inviting. The comfort of an aunt who wants to feed you and show you off. Casual, generous.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 拝見させていただきます、本当に。
lines.en: I'd love to see what you've done. Really.
lines.style: Reverent without being formal. Soft, genuine curiosity. The voice of someone honoring what matters to the other person. Slight pause before 'Really'—absolute sincerity.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こんなふうに、関わってくれて感謝。
lines.en: I'm so grateful you showed up for me like this.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. No performance. Voice opening slightly—vulnerability underneath the gratitude. This matters. The sound of someone recognizing love when it arrives.
